availability.note: KGM AU Torres model page lists one EVX grade (FWD) at $53,690 drive-away incl. metallic paint ($700). The configurator page is JS-rendered and returned no grade list to the fetcher; CarExpert and CarsGuide (price page) both list a single 2WD variant.

listPrice.note: CarExpert spec page: 'prices starting at $55,188' before on-road costs against $58,000 drive-away (Sydney basis). CarsGuide 2026 price page: $55,188 MSRP, one variant. KGM publishes only drive-away: RRP $58,000, currently $52,990 (solid) / $53,690 (metallic) after a $5,010 'Torres EVX Factory Bonus' limited to MY26 cars built in calendar 2025, 'limited time and while stocks last' (KGM model page; The Beep shows the -$5,010 change, bonus from 10 Nov 2025 'ongoing'). Bonus treated as a campaign per price rule 2, so the regular list is kept. Round-trip: $55,188 through calc/onroad.js gives VIC drive-away $58,386, $386 above KGM's flat national $58,000 (which bundles dealer delivery but NSW-level duty); the SUV back-out of $58,000 would give $54,817. The campaign $52,990 backs out to $50,010 (round-trip $52,990).

batteryKwh.note: EV Database: usable 80.6 kWh, nominal 83.0 kWh, BYD Blade LFP. KGM AU MY26 spec sheet gives 'Capacity 80.6 kWh', 390.4 V, unlabelled - matches the usable figure.

rangeKm.note: KGM AU MY26 spec sheet footnote 3: WLTP combined, 18-inch 225/60 R18. Direction test: below EV Database's European WLTP 503 km, so not an NEDC submission; local figure used.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: KGM AU spec sheet: electric energy consumption (combined, WLTP) 186.5 Wh/km, rounded to 18.7. Battery/range gives 17.4; WLTP figure includes charging losses.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: KGM AU spec sheet VDA 'All seats up (to top of seat back)' 465 L - to-the-cover convention; 703 L to roof not used.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: KGM AU spec sheet VDA 'All seats folded down' 1,526 L; measurement height unstated.

seats.note: 60/40 split rear seats, 3 rear top tethers; five seats.

towKg.note: KGM AU spec sheet: braked 1,500 kg, unbraked 500 kg, towball 150 kg.

warrantyYears.note: 7 years bumper to bumper, no general km limit; servicing elsewhere allowed with invoices, so unconditional. HV battery 10 years/unlimited km, 70% SoH.

insuranceAnnual.note: Held value kept. Anchors: kgm-musso-ev-2wd 1850 at $57,130, byd-sealion-7-premium 1650 at $54,990, kia-ev5-air-standard-range 1700 at $56,770; placed above the BYD/Kia for a thin-volume brand with no ANCAP rating, below the Musso EV ute.

depreciationCurve.note: KGM brand convention, identical to kgm-musso-ev. Below mainstream: $5,010 factory bonus on new stock, KGM 2025 sales down 23.7% (held research), no ANCAP rating, CarsGuide notes rivals 'from brands that might hold their value better' (held research).

lowConfidence: kgm-torres-evx-2wd.listPrice: KGM publishes drive-away only; $55,188 is the before-on-roads figure on CarExpert's data-provider page (CarsGuide MSRP likely the same feed). The $5,010 factory bonus ($52,990 drive-away, list-equivalent ~$50,010) has run since Nov 2025 and may be the effective price for all current stock
